info.name: Reservoir DDMS CI-CD v5.0 (M28)
info.description:
RDDMS M28 CI/CD collection. Folders follow the OpenAPI tags (Health, Dataspaces, Write, Resources, Manifest, Query, Well, Seismic, Reservoir) and run top to bottom: 00 Authentication to 99 Cleanup. The Drogon folder uploads the committed fixture data/Demo_Drogon.epc + data/drogon_small.h5 (newman: run with --working-dir at the repository root). Uses environment variables for auth and partition.

Environment variables required:
- Token_Fetch_URL: token endpoint
- CLIENT_ID
- CLIENT_SECRET (or empty for public clients)
- Scope
- grant_type: client_credentials or refresh_token
- refresh_token (if grant_type=refresh_token)
- data-partition-id
- RDDMS_URL: e.g. https://host/api/reservoir-ddms/v2
- graphql_url: the GraphQL endpoint at the service root, e.g. https://host/api/reservoir-ddms/graphql
- LEGAL_URL: OSDU Legal service (optional; D1 is skipped when unset)
- wdms_welllog_id: a Wellbore DDMS WellLog id (optional; WT07 is skipped when unset)
- graphql_url: the GraphQL endpoint at the service root, e.g. https://host/api/reservoir-ddms/graphql
- LEGAL_URL: OSDU Legal service (optional; D1 is skipped when unset)
- wdms_welllog_id: a Wellbore DDMS WellLog id (optional; WT07 is skipped when unset)
- domain: entitlements domain (e.g. .group or .contoso.com)
- defaultLegalTag: (optional, auto-created if missing)
